predecessors.name: Kingdom of Georgia
predecessors.text: Samtskhe, which Qvarqvare II Jaqeli separated from the Georgian king in 1465 after Paravani

successors.name: Kingdom of Imereti
successors.text: Samtskhe, annexed in 1535 by King Bagrat III (of Imereti, by the article's link) after Murjakheti

successors.name: Principality of Guria
successors.text: Adjara and Lazeti, Rostom Gurieli's share of Samtskhe in 1535

ledger.x: 1465: Qvarqvare II Jaqeli defeats King George VIII at Lake Paravani and Samtskhe separates from Georgia.
1535: Rostom Gurieli takes Adjara and Lazeti from Samtskhe.
1535: King Bagrat III, with Rostom Gurieli and Odishian allies, invades Samtskhe, captures Qvarqvare III and annexes the principality.

wars.name: Qvarqvare II's rebellion against George VIII
wars.outcome: Samtskhe separated from Georgia after Qvarqvare II's victory at Lake Paravani (1465); he had called in Uzun Hasan of the Aq Qoyunlu against the Georgian king in 1462.

wars.name: Aq Qoyunlu and Ottoman pressure on Samtskhe
wars.outcome: The page records the attacks without a territorial result: 'The Aq Qoyunlu launched major attacks in 1466, 1476-1477 and 1485 and from 1479 the Ottoman Empire started to encroach on the territories.'

wars.name: Bagrat III's invasion of Samtskhe
wars.outcome: Qvarqvare III captured at Murjakheti; Samtskhe annexed, Rostom Gurieli given Adjara and Lazeti.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is given by the page; the frontiers with Kartli, Imereti, Guria and the Aq Qoyunlu and Ottoman lands are approximate.
